title: A Sui–Tang timeline across three traditions

events.title: Foundation of the Tang dynasty
events.summary: A new imperial order formed the shared political setting for ritual, monasteries, Daoist institutions and textual projects.

events.title: Xuanzang leaves in search of Buddhist learning
events.summary: His journey linked India, Central Asia and Tang China; the date follows the commonly used historical account.

events.title: State commentarial project on the Five Classics
events.summary: The work associated with Kong Yingda connected classical interpretation with state education.

events.title: Xuanzang returns to Chang'an
events.summary: The texts he brought and the translations that followed entered Chang'an's institutional networks.

events.title: Lifetime of Sima Chengzhen
events.summary: His life connects mountain cultivation, Daoist traditions and the Tang court.

events.title: First construction of the Great Wild Goose Pagoda
events.summary: Architecture, textual preservation and the memory of Xuanzang remained connected in later reception.

events.title: Foundation of the Wu Zhou dynasty
events.summary: Imperial authority, Buddhist political language and established ritual order entered a new configuration.

events.title: Huichang-era religious policy turn
events.summary: Tensions among monastic economies, state governance and religious institutions became especially visible.
